list.title: Page heading of the contact list. Noun, plural, 1 word.
list.resultCount: Result count above the table. PLURAL on {count} — Polish needs three forms.
list.columns.email: Table column header: the contact's email address. 1 word.
list.columns.name: Table column header: the contact's name. 1 word.
list.columns.phone: Table column header: the contact's phone number. 1 word.
list.columns.newsletter: Table column header: newsletter subscription status. Glossary: newsletter stays 'newsletter'. 1 word.
list.columns.createdAt: Table column header: when the contact was added. ≤2 words. CSS uppercases headers, so give sentence case.
list.empty.noneTitle: Empty state title when there are no contacts at all. ≤3 words.
list.empty.noneMessage: Empty state body under that title. One sentence naming the two ways to get contacts in: add one, or sync from Listmonk (a newsletter tool — keep the brand name).
list.empty.filteredTitle: Empty state title when filters returned nothing. ≤3 words.
list.empty.filteredMessage: Body under it. Suggest clearing filters. One short sentence.
list.filters.phone: Label above the phone presence filter. 1 word.
list.filters.phoneAny: Option: do not filter by phone. ≤2 words.
list.filters.phoneYes: Option: only contacts with a phone. ≤2 words.
list.filters.phoneNo: Option: only contacts without a phone. ≤2 words.
list.filters.form: Label above the form/interest filter. 1 word.
list.filters.newsletter: Label above the Listmonk sync filter. Glossary: newsletter. 1 word.
list.filters.newsletterSynced: Option: contact exists in Listmonk metadata. ≤2 words. Keep Listmonk brand.
list.filters.newsletterMissing: Option: not synced to Listmonk. ≤2 words.
list.filters.added: Label above the created-at date range filter. ≤1 word.
list.filters.addedPlaceholder: Placeholder when no date range is chosen. ≤2 words.
list.filters.clear: Button that resets all list filters. Imperative, ≤2 words.
list.sync.action: Top-bar button that pulls subscribers in from Listmonk. Imperative, ≤4 words, keep the brand name.
list.sync.running: Label that button shows while the sync runs. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words.
list.sync.result: Success line after a sync. PLURAL on {total} — Polish needs three forms. Also carries {imported} (newly created contacts) and {updated} (existing contacts refreshed). Glossary: subscriber → subskrybent.
list.errors.load: Fallback when the contact list could not be fetched and the server gave no message. No trailing period.
list.errors.sync: Fallback when the Listmonk sync failed. No trailing period.
list.errors.create: Fallback when creating a contact failed. No trailing period.
list.errors.delete: Fallback when deleting a contact failed. No trailing period.
list.create.title: Heading of the 'add a contact' dialog. ≤3 words.
list.create.email: Field label for the contact's email. Required — the asterisk is rendered separately. 1 word.
list.create.name: Field label for the contact's name. Optional. 1 word.
list.create.phone: Field label for the contact's phone number. Optional. 1 word.
list.delete.title: Title of the delete confirmation. A question, ≤4 words. Polish: infinitive, e.g. 'Usunąć kontakt?'.
list.delete.message: Body of that confirmation. {name} is the contact's name or email and must be wrapped in the locale's own quote marks. One sentence, and say the action cannot be undone. This replaces a sentence that used to be split across three DOM nodes.
list.delete.confirm: The destructive button in that confirmation. Names the action AND the object — never a bare 'OK'. ≤3 words.
detail.back: Link back to the contact list from one contact's page. The ← glyph stays in markup. ≤3 words.
detail.editHint: Short helper under the contact title. Name/phone are editable; email is locked until unlocked. One short sentence.
detail.unlockEmail: aria-label + tooltip for the lock icon that unlocks the email field. Imperative, ≤3 words.
detail.lockEmail: aria-label + tooltip for the unlock icon that re-locks the email field and reverts edits. Imperative, ≤3 words.
detail.emailConfirm.title: Title of the confirmation before changing the contact's email. A question, ≤4 words. Polish: infinitive.
detail.emailConfirm.message: Body of that confirmation. {from} is the current email, {to} the new one — wrap both in locale quote marks. Mention mail/sync will follow the new address. One or two short sentences.
detail.emailConfirm.confirm: Destructive confirm button. Names the action + object (Change email), never bare OK. ≤3 words.
detail.noName: Shown in place of the name when the contact has none. Not an error — just absent. ≤3 words.
detail.namePlaceholder: Placeholder in the name field on the contact edit form. ≤2 words.
detail.phonePlaceholder: Placeholder in the phone field. ≤3 words.
detail.fields.email: Label of the email field on the contact edit form. Required — asterisk rendered separately. 1 word.
detail.fields.name: Label of the name field on the contact edit form. Optional. 1 word.
detail.fields.phone: Label of the phone field on the contact edit form. Optional. 1 word.
detail.metadata: Heading above leftover contact metadata that is not listmonk/interests. ≤3 words.
detail.newsletter: Heading above Listmonk subscription details on the contact page. Glossary: newsletter stays. 1 word.
detail.listmonk.status: Label for Listmonk subscription status. 1 word.
detail.listmonk.statusEnabled: Readable value when Listmonk status is enabled. 1 word.
detail.listmonk.statusDisabled: Readable value when Listmonk status is disabled. 1 word.
detail.listmonk.subscriberId: Label for the Listmonk subscriber id. ≤2 words.
detail.listmonk.syncedAt: Label for when the contact was last synced to Listmonk. ≤3 words.
detail.bool.yes: Boolean true shown in read-only field lists. 1 word.
detail.bool.no: Boolean false shown in read-only field lists. 1 word.
detail.leads: Heading above the list of pipeline leads for this contact. PLURAL on {count} — Polish needs three forms. Glossary: lead stays 'lead'.
detail.noLeads: Shown when the contact has no pipeline leads yet. One short sentence.
detail.unknownStage: Fallback when a lead's stage name is missing. ≤2 words.
detail.submissions: Heading above the list of form submissions from this contact. PLURAL on {count} — Polish needs three forms. Glossary: submission → zgłoszenie.
detail.noSubmissions: Shown when the contact has never submitted a form. One short sentence.
detail.formFallback: Used instead of a form's name when it is missing. {id} is the form's raw id. Keep it obviously technical.
detail.source: Label before the URL a submission came from. {url} is the address. ≤2 words plus the value.
detail.errors.load: Fallback when the contact could not be fetched. No trailing period.
detail.errors.save: Fallback when saving the contact failed for a generic reason. No trailing period.
detail.errors.emailTaken: Shown when saving fails because another contact already uses that email (HTTP 409). One short sentence. No trailing period.
detail.customFields: Heading above operator-defined extra fields on the contact card. ≤3 words.
list.import.action: Top-bar button that opens CSV import. Imperative, 1 word.
list.import.title: Heading of the CSV import dialog. ≤3 words.
list.import.pickFile: Label on the file picker in the import dialog. Imperative, ≤3 words.
list.import.mappingHint: Helper under the column-mapping table. One short sentence: first row is headers, map the email column.
list.import.column: Table header: original CSV column name. 1 word.
list.import.mapTo: Table header: which contact field this column fills. ≤2 words.
list.import.skipColumn: Option in the mapping dropdown: ignore this column. ≤2 words.
list.import.submit: Primary button that starts the import after mapping. Imperative, ≤2 words.
list.import.submitting: Label that button shows while the request runs. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words.
list.import.resultTitle: Heading of the import summary after submit. ≤3 words.
list.import.imported: Summary line: how many contacts were created. PLURAL on {count} — Polish needs three forms.
list.import.skipped: Summary line: how many rows were skipped as duplicate emails. PLURAL on {count}.
list.import.errorsTitle: Heading above the list of rejected rows. ≤3 words.
list.import.errorRow: One rejected row. {row} is the 1-based data-row number, {reason} is already-translated. Keep the number visible.
list.import.close: Button that dismisses the import dialog after results. 1 word.
list.import.noHeaders: Error when the file has no header row. One short sentence. No trailing period.
list.import.noEmail: Error when the operator has not mapped a column to email. One short sentence. No trailing period.
list.import.tooLarge: Error when the file has more than 1000 data rows (HTTP 413). One short sentence. No trailing period.
list.import.failed: Fallback when import POST fails for a generic reason. No trailing period.
list.import.reasons.missing_email: Per-row reason: that row had no email. Short phrase. No trailing period.
list.import.reasons.invalid_select: Per-row reason: a select custom-field value was not in the field's options. Short phrase. No trailing period.
list.import.reasons.invalid_number: Per-row reason: a number custom-field value was not a number. Short phrase. No trailing period.
list.import.reasons.invalid_date: Per-row reason: a date custom-field value was not YYYY-MM-DD. Short phrase. No trailing period.
list.import.dest.email: Mapping dropdown option: the contact email field. 1 word.
list.import.dest.name: Mapping dropdown option: the contact name field. 1 word.
list.import.dest.phone: Mapping dropdown option: the contact phone field. 1 word.
list.filters.customField: Label above the custom-field filter (which extra field to filter by). ≤2 words.
list.filters.customFieldAny: Option: do not filter by a custom field. ≤2 words.
list.filters.customFieldValue: aria-label of the value control next to the custom-field picker. ≤2 words.
customFields.title: Page heading of Settings → Custom fields. Noun, ≤3 words.
customFields.emptyTitle: Empty-state title when no custom fields exist yet. ≤3 words.
customFields.emptyMessage: Empty-state body: extra columns on contacts, defined here. One short sentence.
customFields.add: Button that opens the add-field form. Imperative, ≤2 words.
customFields.name: Label of the field's operator-facing name. 1 word.
customFields.type: Label of the field type picker. 1 word.
customFields.options: Label of the select-options input. 1 word, plural.
customFields.optionsHint: Hint under options: one option per line. One short sentence.
customFields.create: Submit button on the add-field form. Imperative, ≤2 words.
customFields.creating: That button while the request runs. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words.
customFields.cancel: Button that closes the add-field form without saving. 1 word.
customFields.delete: Row action that deletes a definition. 1 word.
customFields.deleteTitle: Title of the delete confirmation. A question, ≤4 words. Polish: infinitive.
customFields.deleteMessage: Body of that confirmation. {name} is the field's name — wrap in locale quote marks. Say values already on contacts stay stored but stop showing. One or two short sentences.
customFields.deleteConfirm: Destructive confirm button. Names action + object. ≤3 words.
customFields.types.date: Type option: a calendar day. 1 word.
customFields.types.select: Type option: pick from a list. 1 word.
customFields.errors.load: Fallback when definitions could not be fetched. No trailing period.
customFields.errors.create: Fallback when creating a field failed. No trailing period.
customFields.errors.delete: Fallback when deleting a field failed. No trailing period.
customFields.errors.selectOptions: Inline error: select type needs at least one option. One short sentence. No trailing period.
customFields.errors.slugTaken: Shown when create fails because that name collides after slugify (HTTP 409). One short sentence. No trailing period.
